{{Top|leg}}
'''Imperial Space Systems Command''' was an organization of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] that oversaw the certification of systems used onboard Imperial [[Starship/Legends|starships]].

==History==
The [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Avenger/Legends|''Avenger'']] had its systems checked out and certified by the ISSC, which was noted on its Commemorative Christening Plate.
